proof.step_1_row_multilinearity: Expand det(K^(r)) using row_x=sum_{y!=x}T(x,y)b_{x->y}. This gives a finite sum over parent-choice data p:V->A with p(x)!=x.
proof.step_2_grouped_term: Each parent datum p contributes weight product_{x in V}T(x,p(x)) times det(B_p), where row_x(B_p)=b_{x->p(x)}.
proof.step_3_cycle_coefficient: The exact cancellation certificate proves det(B_p)=0 whenever p contains a directed cycle entirely in V, and det(B_p)=1 otherwise.
proof.step_4_survivors: Because V is finite and every x has exactly one p-successor, absence of a cycle in V is equivalent to every p-iterate reaching r.
proof.step_5_sum: Therefore only rooted parent maps survive, each with coefficient +1 and multiplicity weight product_x T(x,p(x)), exactly the frozen Stage-D definition of TAU_r(T).

statement: For every positive realizable finite T and frozen Stage-D root r, TAU_r(T)=det(K^(r)).
weakest_semantic_statement: Exact determinant/cofactor computes an already-derived N2 relational count; determinant is not N0 ontology.
